title.en: The audio device is in exclusive use
title.zh-CN: 音频设备被其他程序独占

fix.en: In Sound settings, open the device's properties, and on the Advanced tab clear "Allow applications to take exclusive control of this device".
fix.zh-CN: 在声音设置中打开该设备的属性，在“高级”选项卡里取消勾选“允许应用程序独占控制该设备”。

title.en: Microphone access is blocked

fix.en: Turn on microphone access for desktop apps in the system privacy settings, then restart capture.
fix.zh-CN: 在系统隐私设置里允许桌面应用访问麦克风，然后重新开始拾取。

title.en: No usable audio device was found
title.zh-CN: 找不到可用的音频设备

fix.en: Connect a microphone or speakers, make sure they are enabled in Sound settings, then pick them again in Settings › Audio.
fix.zh-CN: 连接麦克风或扬声器，确认它们在声音设置中已启用，然后在 设置 › 音频 中重新选择。

title.en: The audio device changed; capture restarted
title.zh-CN: 音频设备已切换，采集已自动恢复

fix.en: Nothing to do. If the level bars stay flat, pick the device again in Settings › Audio.
fix.zh-CN: 无需操作。若电平条不再跳动，请在 设置 › 音频 中重新选择设备。

title.en: System sound capture receives only silence
title.zh-CN: 系统声音通道只收到静音

fix.en: Check that the meeting plays through the default output device. Mute your speakers or use headphones while testing so the microphone does not pick up the sound instead.
fix.zh-CN: 确认会议声音从默认播放设备输出。测试时将扬声器静音或戴上耳机，避免麦克风代替环回通道录到声音。

title.en: Audio capture is not available on this platform yet
title.zh-CN: 此平台暂不支持音频采集

fix.en: This build supports audio capture on Windows only. Practice mode with simulated latency still works.
fix.zh-CN: 当前版本只在 Windows 上支持音频采集。练习模式的“模拟延迟”方式仍可使用。

title.en: The speech recognition API key was rejected
title.zh-CN: 语音识别 API 密钥无效

fix.en: Copy the key again from the provider console, paste it in Settings › Providers, and select Verify.
fix.zh-CN: 从供应商控制台重新复制密钥，粘贴到 设置 › 供应商与费用 中，然后点“验证”。

title.en: Could not connect to the speech recognition service
title.zh-CN: 无法连接语音识别服务

fix.en: Check your network or proxy, then run the latency probe to pick a reachable endpoint.
fix.zh-CN: 检查网络或代理设置，然后运行延迟探测，选择一个可以连通的端点。

title.en: The speech recognition service is limiting requests

fix.en: Wait a minute and try again. If it keeps happening, check the quota and balance in the provider console.
fix.zh-CN: 稍等一分钟再试。如果反复出现，请到供应商控制台检查配额与余额。

title.en: The speech recognition service returned an unexpected response
title.zh-CN: 语音识别服务返回了无法识别的响应

fix.en: Update MeetCue to the latest version. If the problem persists, export diagnostics and open an issue.
fix.zh-CN: 将 MeetCue 升级到最新版本。若问题仍在，请导出诊断信息并提交 Issue。

title.en: No speech recognition provider is set up
title.zh-CN: 尚未配置语音识别供应商

fix.en: Choose a provider and enter its API key in Settings › Providers, or start demo mode to try MeetCue without keys.
fix.zh-CN: 在 设置 › 供应商与费用 中选择供应商并填写密钥，或者用演示模式在没有密钥的情况下体验。

title.en: Hint generation timed out

fix.en: Run the latency probe and switch to a faster model or endpoint. Hints for the next question are generated as usual.
fix.zh-CN: 运行延迟探测，换用更快的模型或端点。下一个问题会照常生成提示。

title.en: The language model API key was rejected
title.zh-CN: 大模型 API 密钥无效

fix.en: Copy the key again from the provider console, paste it in Settings › Providers, and select Verify.
fix.zh-CN: 从供应商控制台重新复制密钥，粘贴到 设置 › 供应商与费用 中，然后点“验证”。

title.en: The language model service is limiting requests

fix.en: MeetCue retries automatically. If it keeps happening, check the rate limits and balance of your account.
fix.zh-CN: MeetCue 会自动重试。如果反复出现，请检查账户的速率限制与余额。

title.en: The selected model is not available

fix.en: Pick another model in Settings › Providers.
fix.zh-CN: 在 设置 › 供应商与费用 中换一个模型。

title.en: The language model request failed

fix.en: Check your network and the provider status page, then try again.
fix.zh-CN: 检查网络与供应商的服务状态页，然后重试。

title.en: The model's answer could not be read

fix.en: Usually a one-off. If it happens often, choose a more capable model for hint generation.
fix.zh-CN: 通常只是偶发。若经常出现，请为要点生成选择能力更强的模型。

title.en: A shortcut is already used by another program
title.zh-CN: 快捷键已被其他程序占用

fix.en: Open Settings › Shortcuts and assign a different key combination to the item marked in red.
fix.zh-CN: 打开 设置 › 快捷键，为标红的项目换一个组合键。

title.en: The WebView2 runtime is missing

fix.en: Install the Evergreen WebView2 Runtime from Microsoft, then start MeetCue again.
fix.zh-CN: 从微软官网安装 Evergreen 版 WebView2 运行时，然后重新启动 MeetCue。

title.en: The settings folder is not writable

fix.en: MeetCue saved settings to your user profile instead. Check the folder permissions if you want portable settings.
fix.zh-CN: MeetCue 已改为把设置保存在用户目录中。如需便携配置，请检查程序目录的写入权限。

title.en: The system credential store is unavailable

fix.en: API keys are kept only in the system credential store. Make sure it is running (Credential Manager, Keychain or Secret Service) and try again.
fix.zh-CN: API 密钥只保存在系统凭据库中。请确认凭据服务（凭据管理器、钥匙串或 Secret Service）正常运行后重试。

title.en: This feature is not supported on this platform yet
title.zh-CN: 此平台暂不支持该功能

fix.en: The feature is planned for a later release. See the platform support table in the docs.
fix.zh-CN: 该功能将在后续版本中支持，请查看文档中的平台支持表。

title.en: A secure connection could not be established

fix.en: If your network uses an HTTPS proxy, set the proxy address in Settings › Providers › Advanced and make sure its certificate is trusted by the system.
fix.zh-CN: 如果所在网络使用 HTTPS 代理，请在 设置 › 供应商与费用 › 高级 中填写代理地址，并确认系统信任其证书。

title.en: 80% of the budget is used

fix.en: Spending is close to the limit you set. Adjust the budget in Settings › Providers if needed.
fix.zh-CN: 花费已接近你设定的上限，如有需要可在 设置 › 供应商与费用 中调整预算。

title.en: The budget is used up

fix.en: MeetCue applied the action you chose for this case. Raise the budget in Settings › Providers to continue.
fix.zh-CN: MeetCue 已按你的设置处理。如需继续，请在 设置 › 供应商与费用 中提高预算。

title.en: The practice file could not be read

fix.en: Use an .srt, .vtt, .txt, .md or .csv file. See the file format reference for examples.
fix.zh-CN: 请使用 .srt、.vtt、.txt、.md 或 .csv 文件，格式示例见“文件格式”参考页。

title.en: Speech synthesis is not available

fix.en: Install a text-to-speech voice for the question language in the system settings, or practice with on-screen questions only.
fix.zh-CN: 在系统设置中安装对应语言的语音，或改为只在屏幕上显示问题进行练习。

title.en: Diagnostics could not be exported

fix.en: Pick a folder you can write to, for example Documents, and try again.
fix.zh-CN: 换一个有写入权限的文件夹（例如“文档”）后重试。
